## SelectMind AI Desktop for Windows (x64)

First public release — Chrome extension + Windows desktop app sharing the same AI core.

### Install

1. Download **SelectMind AI_0.1.0_x64-setup.exe** below
2. Run the installer
3. Add your AI provider API key in Settings

### Default hotkeys

| Hotkey | Action |
|--------|--------|
| `Ctrl+Shift+Space` | Toolbar for selected text |
| `Ctrl+Shift+O` | OCR toolbar (games, images) |
| `Ctrl+Shift+X` | OCR to chat |
| `Ctrl+Shift+P` | Command palette |

### SmartScreen notice

This build is **unsigned** (no code signing certificate yet). Windows may show "Unknown publisher" — click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. Install only from this GitHub Release.

### Requirements

- Windows 10/11 x64
- Internet connection for AI providers

### Chrome extension

Install the browser extension from source — see [README](https://github.com/dimovitus/selectmind-ai#install-development).
